0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, 14th in the East and 4 games back in the Central) head to Philadelphia on a four-game losing streak to face the 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic), who have won two straight. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring, out) and Dailyn Swain (back soreness, day-to-day with a game-time decision), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, out for surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture, out), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain, out). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, though the Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, and the last meeting was a 157-137 Philadelphia win on March 25, 2026, in Philadelphia.
